title: Application of Massachusetts Electric Company and Nantucket Electric Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by /st. 1981, c. 375 and the Massachusetts Electric Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. No. 797, for approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy of a change in the quarterly Power Cost Charge to be billed to the Companies' customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of January and February, 1998. The Power Cost Charge reflects changes in prudently incurred, reasonable costs of fules and power purchased by the Companies. Application is also made by Massachusetts electric Company and Nantucket Electric Company for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filings to be made by utilities with the Department, and implement the intent of §§ 201 and 210 of the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
